verdicts.reason: Both shrink the 'SOLSTICE BOTANICAL SPARKLING' brand line to an illegible red dash, so the brand name is effectively lost. A also pins the headline to the top and leaves a large dead void through the middle. B centres the headline block vertically with slightly larger type, which is better balanced, but it has the same unreadable brand line and loose empty space above and below.

In both, the brand line is reduced to an unreadable sliver, and a big empty band sits between the headline and the decorative circle. A has a top-heavy headline and a dead middle.
